title: Orthogonality of sign monomials
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer and let $S,T$ be subsets of the $n$ coordinates. The uniform average of the product of the sign monomials indexed by $S$ and $T$ is $1$ when $S=T$ and $0$ otherwise.
